-------------------------TRY_TRADES----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,2),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Nominal)),0) Nominal_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),SettlementAmount)),0) SettlementAmount_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount)),0) Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount)),0) Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount)),0) Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Principal_Amount)),0) Principal_Amount_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM)),0) Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,2),Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount)),0) Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_TRADES WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,Nominal Nominal_src
,SettlementAmount SettlementAmount_src
,Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_src
,Principal_Amount Principal_Amount_src
,Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_src
,Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_TRADES WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,Nominal_src
,SettlementAmount_src
,Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_src
,Principal_Amount_src
,Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_src
,Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_src
,Nominal_tgt
,SettlementAmount_tgt
,Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Principal_Amount_tgt
,Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_tgt
,Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,2)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,2)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(Nominal_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Nominal_src
,CAST(SettlementAmount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) SettlementAmount_src
,CAST(Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_src
,CAST(Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_src
,CAST(Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_src
,CAST(Principal_Amount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Principal_Amount_src
,CAST(Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_src
,CAST(Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_src AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_src
,CAST(Nominal_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Nominal_tgt
,CAST(SettlementAmount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) SettlementAmount_tgt
,CAST(Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_tgt
,CAST(Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_tgt
,CAST(Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_tgt
,CAST(Principal_Amount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Principal_Amount_tgt
,CAST(Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_tgt
,CAST(Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,2)) Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,Nominal_src
,SettlementAmount_src
,Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_src
,Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_src
,Principal_Amount_src
,Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_src
,Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,Nominal_tgt
,SettlementAmount_tgt
,Fee_FI_TBC_COMM_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Fee_FI_ODB_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Fee_FI_CUST_MAIN_FEE_Amount_tgt
,Principal_Amount_tgt
,Pricer_WITHHOLDINGTAX_AM_tgt
,Fee_MM_DST_INT_FEE_Amount_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
